release_notes_summary: Clear Inputs across calculators and improved Vehicle Data search, selection, resizing and VIN handling.
notes: Adds Clear Inputs to every calculator panel, including Vehicle Lookup. Clears entered data, results, warnings and temporary converted values while restoring default unit and mode choices.
Adds Clear Search in Vehicle Data while preserving installed local data and saved case vehicle profiles and links.
Improves Vehicle Data with separate Search, VIN Decode and Local Data tabs, wider dropdown lists, and a draggable list/details divider. Details can collapse to enlarge the vehicle list.
Improves keyboard search, selection-dependent button feedback and VIN edits so an old decode cannot be reused after changing the VIN.

Preserves existing calculations and the update-download Save As workflow. Close the app before manually replacing the portable folder; preserve your cases and settings. Automatic update installation remains disabled.
Experimental — physical validation pending; not qualified for casework use.

This restriction continues to apply to off-axis correction and remains in Results, Show Work and exports. Software tests do not establish physical accuracy. Ground-force partition results are not automatically transferred to downstream calculators.

The public package retains the previously published reference bundle. Eighteen internal course/reference files, photographs and review notes remain excluded; their bibliographic citations are retained, but their document copies are not included.
